pages.title: Rough Around the Edges
pages.text: Learn the pack’s maintenance cycle before expensive digging jobs.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Read the wear shown by Jade. Stop the mechanism and perform the existing repair interaction with iron; attempting service on an unworn drill does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use actual drill wear and stopped iron service. Obsidian/bedrock have special consequences; current owner supplies exact limits rather than historical notes.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Jade/JEI expose native drill state/service; adapters do not create second wear state or infinite repairs.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Current3.7.0 may contain additional adapters; old2.0.0 JAR notes do not establish its complete feature inventory. Current internal completeness remains unverified pending owner-source inspection.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: World tier/equipment classification delegate to their canonical owner when present. AI/element/durability adapters create no second progression authority and no unverified numerical promise.
